flags: Subtopic not in catalog. 'Altitudes and Sides of a Triangle' is invented. The chapter's six listed subtopics are congruence/similarity, Pythagoras and its converse, centres of a triangle, basic proportionality and angle bisector, ratio of AREAS of triangles, and angles of a triangle. This item turns on none of them: it uses side x altitude = 2 x area (constant across the three altitudes of one triangle), so a side is inversely proportional to the altitude drawn to it, converting a ratio of altitudes into a ratio of sides. 'Ratio of Areas of Triangles' is the nearest listed name and means something genuinely different (comparing the areas of two triangles), so it was not forced.
